name: Tuna, Lentil & Feta Salad
steps: Peel and slice the red onion and add it to a large mixing bowl. Pour in the red wine vinegar, add the dried oregano, capers and olive oil, then season with salt and pepper. Whisk everything together to make a punchy dressing.
Finely chop the mint and stir it through the dressing.
Drain and rinse the lentils and butter beans, then chuck them into the bowl and toss well to coat.
Drain the tuna and crumble the feta.

Serve up the salad into Tupperware containers and top with the tuna and feta. Finish with a crack of black pepper. Box up and pop in the fridge, ready for when you need it. These keep for 3 days in the fridge.
